title: COME AND DINE
author: C.B. Widneyer
stanzas: Jesus has a table spread Where the saints of God are fed. He invites His chosen people, "COme and dine" With Hid manna He doth feed, And supplies our ev'ry need; O 'tis sweet to sup with Jesus all the time!

The disciples came to land, Thus obeying Christ's command, For the Master called to them, "O come and dine," There they found their heart's desire, Bread and fish upon the fire; Thus He satisfies the hungry ev'ry time.

Soon the lamb will take the bride, To be ever at His side, All the Host of heaven will assembled be; O 'twil be a glorious sight, All the saints in spotless white; And with Jesus they will feast eternally.
